title: NSClient V3, AAPS Full, Client1 and Client2; Websockets are disconnected on startup and restart of AAPS 3.3.3.0 -dev b
symptom: Websockets are disconnected on startup or restart of App, affecting AAPS Full, Client 1, and Client 2. This results in inability to set TTs, Treatments, or profile changes via client. The issue occurs daily and is critical in a parental setup.
fix: The thread references a commit (fdd17476faa173d49d1a1ffe0306d613765ba45a) which likely contains a fix, but the thread does not explicitly state the fix details.
evidence_quote: The issue occurs daily. I just got called by a caretaker that her Phone Running AAPSClient got no date. Disonnected Websockets was the issue.
